Pete Hegseth Impeachment: Republican Representative Thomas Massie on Monday moved to compel a House vote on impeaching Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, setting up a test of support for one of President Donald Trump’s most prominent Cabinet officials after the party’s heavy midterm losses. Both Democrats and a section of the Republicans are backing the impeachment move.
